Option C: KClO3 -> KCl + O2. Breaking it down, KClO3 has 1 K, 1 Cl, 3 O. On the right, KCl has 1 K, 1 Cl, and O2 has 2 O. So K and Cl are balanced, but O isn't. KClO3 has 3 O, and O2 only has 2 O. So C is unbalanced too.

Option D: H2 + O2 -> H2O. Let's see. H2 has 2 H, O2 has 2 O. On the right, H2O has 2 H and 2 O. So H and O are balanced. This equation is correct and shows conservation of mass.
